original_query: select    min(w_state)   ,min(i_item_id)   ,min(cs_item_sk)   ,min(cs_order_number)   ,min(cr_item_sk)   ,min(cr_order_number)  from    catalog_sales left outer join catalog_returns on        (cs_order_number = cr_order_number         and cs_item_sk = cr_item_sk)   ,warehouse   ,item   ,date_dim  where  i_item_sk          = cs_item_sk  and cs_warehouse_sk    = w_warehouse_sk  and cs_sold_date_sk    = d_date_sk  and d_date between (cast ('1998-04-26' as date) - interval '30' day)                 and (cast ('1998-04-26' as date) + interval '30' day)   and i_category  = 'Home'  and i_manager_id between 28 and 67  and cs_wholesale_cost between 69 and 88  and cr_reason_sk = 11 ;
rewritten_query:
select min(w_state), min(i_item_id), min(cs_item_sk), min(cs_order_number), min(cr_item_sk), min(cr_order_number)
from catalog_sales cs
join warehouse w on w.w_warehouse_sk = cs.cs_warehouse_sk
join item i on i.i_item_sk = cs.cs_item_sk
join date_dim d on d.d_date_sk = cs.cs_sold_date_sk
join catalog_returns cr on cr.cr_order_number = cs.cs_order_number and cr.cr_item_sk = cs.cs_item_sk
where d.d_date between date '1998-03-27' and date '1998-05-26'
  and i.i_category = 'Home'
  and i.i_manager_id between 28 and 67
  and cs.cs_wholesale_cost between 69 and 88
  and cr.cr_reason_sk = 11;

rewrite_suggestion.produced_suggestion: The LEFT OUTER JOIN to catalog_returns combined with WHERE cr_reason_sk = 11 effectively becomes an INNER JOIN (null-extended rows are filtered out), so it is rewritten as an explicit inner join. Mixed comma-join/ANSI-join syntax is also replaced with explicit JOINs for readability and safer join reordering.

The date expression cast('1998-04-26' as date) +/- interval '30' day is precomputed to the literals DATE '1998-03-27' and DATE '1998-05-26', which is equivalent (both endpoints inclusive) and removes runtime date arithmetic.

No CTE is needed: the query is a simple star join with no redundant subquery computation. The optimizer can freely reorder inner joins; an index on catalog_sales(cs_sold_date_sk) and the existing catalog_returns primary key (cr_item_sk, cr_order_number) support the plan. Optionally, a composite index catalog_returns(cr_reason_sk, cr_order_number, cr_item_sk) could help if the date range were much wider.
